findings.requirement: Exact-head quantitative evidence must be produced by a checkout whose measured SHA equals the declared material subject SHA.
findings.summary: The prior workflow tested the pull-request merge ref while the evidence manifest certified the material head as exact.

findings.requirement: The delivery specification snapshot and closure must cover the full immutable issue body, including all normative scenarios and acceptance criteria.
findings.summary: The prior certified source was a condensed 42-line summary rather than the full issue body.

findings.requirement: Meal correction and user-learned household-measure persistence must be atomic against concurrent stale corrections.
findings.summary: Split writes could leave a final meal value and learned relation from different concurrent corrections.
